correctness.rationale: For n>=3 the cyclic transfer-trace Cayley–Hamilton identity reduces partition zeros to Q_n(x)=xU_(n-1)(x)+λU_(n-2)(x) with λ=(exp(-2(K+L))-1)/(1-exp(-4K)). For λ<=0 an explicit symmetric Jacobi realization gives real roots and Q_n(±1/c)≠0 inside physical range; for even n any λ>0 yields an imaginary-root pair. For odd n the positive roots interlace until λ=1/(n-1), where a triple x=0 occurs; beyond this F_m(iy) changes sign and the reciprocal negative fugacity pair leaves the circle. Verified n=3..10 direct original spin partition polynomials at both sides of thresholds (32 checks); finite tests support unrestricted root argument, not replace it.
